title: Align ExitPlanMode tool with the TS baseline
objective: Implement all ExitPlanMode improvements identified by the per-tool subagent report so the Go clone matches the original TypeScript tool in public contract, runtime logic, robustness, state lifecycle, and tests.

context.problem: Go 版本已经具备基础工具名、allowedPrompts 入参、计划文件读取、edited plan 持久化、本地 PlanState 退出、结构化 JSON 响应、部分 auto gate fallback 与 allowed prompt matcher。但与当前 TS 基准 ExitPlanModeV2Tool 相比，核心运行时仍不是同一个生命周期：TS 通过 deferred tool + permission dialog/approval UI 驱动用户批准或拒绝，按用户选择恢复/切换权限模式，必要时清空上下文并重启执行，会为 teammate 走 team-lead mailbox 审批，并把 approved/awaiting/rejected 状态映射成模型可消费的 tool_result 文本；Go 当前是在 Execute 中直接退出 PlanState 并返回自定义 JSON 信封，缺少审批前置、teammate 请求、permission context 恢复、approved-plan tool_result 映射、allowedPrompts 到权限规则的实际授权，以及若干可用性/鲁棒性/SDK 归一逻辑。

improvement_points.title: Go 总是注册/可发现 ExitPlanMode，缺少 TS 的 channels 可用性门和完整工具元数据语义
Go 执行时直接退出 plan mode，缺少 TS 的本地用户审批、拒绝、反馈、编辑计划和 sticky approval UI
Go 的 ExitPlanMode 没有 TS teammate plan_mode_required 的 team-lead mailbox 审批分支
Go 保存了 pre-plan snapshot 但 ExitPlanMode 不消费它，缺少 TS 的 prePlanMode/auto-mode/dangerous-permission 恢复逻辑
Go 的成功输出结构和模型可见 tool_result 与 TS V2 不一致
Go 保存/展示 allowedPrompts，但没有像 TS 一样把它们转换为会话权限规则
Go 在读取计划文件前就退出状态，并把读取失败静默降级为空计划
Go 缺少 TS 的 SDK-facing plan/planFilePath 归一，并引入了未在 schema 中声明的 autoMode 入参
Go 测试覆盖集中在本地 JSON/PlanState，缺少 TS 关键分支的红测

implementation_subtasks.title: Add focused ExitPlanMode parity red tests for TS-critical branches
acceptance_criteria: Tests fail against the current Go implementation for: approval required before local exit, rejection preserves plan mode, teammate plan_approval_request is emitted instead of local exit, approved teammate response exits to inherited mode, pre-plan permission mode is restored, model-visible result text matches TS branches, allowedPrompts unlock Bash permissions, and unreadable plan file preserves plan mode.
Existing passing tests remain in place and are not rewritten to a weaker Go-specific JSON contract.
Each red test cites the corresponding TS evidence path in a comment.

implementation_subtasks.title: Implement ExitPlanMode availability/isEnabled parity for channel/non-interactive contexts
acceptance_criteria: ExitPlanMode remains deferred/searchable in normal local sessions.
ExitPlanMode is not exposed when the runtime is in a channel/non-local-approval context equivalent to TS KAIROS/KAIROS_CHANNELS allowed channels.
EnterPlanMode and ExitPlanMode gates remain symmetric so plan mode cannot become a trap.

implementation_subtasks.title: Add local ExitPlanMode approval/rejection lifecycle before state exit
acceptance_criteria: For non-teammate local sessions, calling ExitPlanMode creates/uses an approval request and does not clear PlanState until approval is received.
Rejecting the plan returns a rejection result/feedback path and leaves PlanState active with the same plan file.
Approving can pass edited plan content through and persists it before exit.
Empty plans require an explicit approval path; unreadable/missing plan files return an error and preserve plan mode unless the user explicitly approved an empty plan case.

implementation_subtasks.title: Implement teammate plan_mode_required mailbox approval flow
acceptance_criteria: When the current runtime is a plan_mode_required teammate, ExitPlanMode requires a non-empty plan and sends a plan_approval_request to team-lead with from, timestamp, planFilePath, planContent, and requestId.
The teammate returns an awaitingLeaderApproval-style result and does not clear local plan mode immediately.
Only team-lead plan_approval_response messages can approve/reject the pending request.
Approved responses exit plan mode and inherit the leader permission mode; rejected responses keep plan mode active and surface feedback.

implementation_subtasks.title: Restore pre-plan permission mode and auto-mode safety state on ExitPlanMode
acceptance_criteria: Entering plan mode records enough pre-plan permission state to restore default/ask/accept-edits/auto-like modes on approved exit.
ExitPlanMode consumes that state and clears it only after successful approval/exit.
Auto-mode gate fallback is derived from runtime permission state and gate availability, not from a model-supplied hidden autoMode flag.
Dangerous permissions stripped for auto-mode-in-plan are restored or kept stripped according to the TS restoreMode rules.
TUI mode, permission checker mode, persisted plan state, and any lifecycle attachment/notification flags stay synchronized.

implementation_subtasks.title: Align ExitPlanMode output data and model-visible tool_result mapping with TS V2
acceptance_criteria: ExitPlanMode internal output includes TS V2 fields: plan, isAgent, filePath, hasTaskTool, planWasEdited, awaitingLeaderApproval, and requestId where applicable.
The model-visible tool_result text matches TS branches for awaiting leader approval, agent invocation, empty plan, and approved plan with path/team hint.
Go-specific JSON fields decision/allowed_prompts_count/kind are removed from the TS-parity output path or confined to non-model metadata if still needed internally.
TUI rendering can use structured data without dumping raw JSON as the user-facing result.

implementation_subtasks.title: Make approved allowedPrompts grant post-exit Bash permissions
acceptance_criteria: Approved allowedPrompts are converted into session allow rules or otherwise consumed by Bash permission checks after plan exit.
Prompt matching honors TS-compatible prompt: semantics, tool Bash enum, duplicate handling, and existing glob/regex/literal matching tests.
Read-only Bash behavior remains unchanged.
Rejected plan exits do not grant allowedPrompts.

implementation_subtasks.title: Add ExitPlanMode SDK/hook input normalization and remove hidden autoMode dependency
acceptance_criteria: Model-facing ExitPlanMode schema remains aligned to TS allowedPrompts behavior.
SDK/hook-visible tool_use input can include normalized plan and planFilePath/plan_path equivalent when a plan exists.
ExitPlanMode no longer needs a hidden autoMode field to decide auto fallback behavior.
Unknown passthrough fields remain tolerated where the broader Go tool parser expects that behavior.
ExitPlanMode input validation and schema behavior match the original TS implementation for all report gaps.
ExitPlanMode model-visible output and structured result data match TS golden fixtures.
ExitPlanMode runtime side effects, state transitions, permission decisions, and error branches listed in improvement_points are implemented or explicitly documented as intentionally out of scope.
All implementation_subtasks acceptance criteria are satisfied.
